Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring notice to property owners when a county, city, or town modifies its zoning requirements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to notifying property owners of proposals to modifyzoning requirements; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 35A.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter36.70 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any city or town that is considering a proposal to rezone privateproperty must ensure that, prior to the adoption of any rezone, noticeof the initial proposal is provided to the owners of the real propertyfor which the rezone would apply.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any city that is considering a proposal to rezone private propertymust ensure that, prior to the adoption of any rezone, notice of theinitial proposal is provided to the owners of the real property forwhich the rezone would apply.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any county that is considering a proposal to rezone privateproperty must ensure that, prior to the adoption of any rezone, noticeof the initial proposal is provided to the owners of the real propertyfor which the rezone would apply.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any county, city, or town that is considering a proposal to rezoneprivate property must ensure that, prior to the adoption of any rezone,notice of the initial proposal is provided to the owners of the realproperty for which the rezone would apply.
